top_signals.title: Asia Spot LNG Prices Hit 5-Month High as Hormuz Blockage Drags On
top_signals.summary: Spot LNG prices in Asia jumped on Tuesday to the highest level since the 2026 winter, as buyers compete for spot cargoes amid the still-stalled LNG traffic through the Strait of Hormuz. Asia’s spot LNG price jumped to as high as $24.614 per million British thermal units (MMBtu) on Tuesday, traders told Bloomberg. This was higher than the $23.388 per MMBtu from Friday, and the highest spot price for LNG deliveries into Asia in five months.
